summary: Narrow steep lane with hedges at the kerb and homes about 13 m away.
reasons: Narrow lane, no room to pull off

drivers.seclusion: Houses front the east kerb within 13-20 m, partly screened by trees; more homes across the lane.
drivers.access_and_room: Lane is about one and a half cars wide with trees, hedges and fences hard against the kerb; no clear ground to stop off the carriageway.
drivers.traffic: Quiet local lane near a junction.
drivers.convention: A ute and a car are parked near the top on the west side only; none on this side.
